Both changes are in the form, and it now validates.

- **Main colour:** set to dark green `#1B5E20` in the default theme ("Thème par défaut" > Couleur principale). The form is in simplified colour mode, so saving the draft will recalculate the other palettes (dark, high contrast) and the text colours from this value, which may overwrite any colours set by hand. I did not check the rendered result.
- **Menu:** added a "Page libre" entry at the end of the navigation bar, pointing to the page "Nos actions pour la jeunesse" (slug `jeunesse`). I left its label and icon empty, so the menu will show the page's own title. The existing Accueil and Catalogue de données entries are unchanged.
